name: salad-bar
description: Small Claude Code plugins for running AI coding sessions without trusting them blindly. Pick what you want.

plugins.name: noticeboard
plugins.description: Lets your sessions, on one machine or several, leave each other posts in a folder you already sync. No server.

plugins.name: whats-open
plugins.description: One read-only report of unfinished git work across all your repos.

plugins.name: last-drinks
plugins.description: Every session ends landed or parked: it lands each branch after the repo's checks, or parks it with a note to resume from, and lists what needs you. Never deploys.
